pages.title: XP sources
pages.text: Kill XP scales with the target’s maximum health and attack. A first mining, crafting, smelting, fishing or trading discovery gives 10, 15, 8, 20 or 10 XP respectively.

pages.title: The next level
pages.text: Through level 200, each level costs 20 more XP than the last. Level 1 costs 100 and level 10 costs 280. Check the screen for your current progress. Spawner mobs grant no kill XP by default.
